module: Unit tests of the global utility functions of `utils` (colors, strings, tables, JSON, serialization, copying, paths, sorted/shuffled iterators), to run with testFramework/TestManager. Launch: `require('testFramework/TestManager'):runTestFiles('utils')` in the GE console. Useful to a modder as examples of the expected behavior (edge cases included) of the global helpers.
notes: Each function takes a context `ctx` provided by TestManager and is not meant to be called directly; the file does `require('utils')` to load the helpers.
Several "NoGarbage"/"single-shot" tests check an allocation budget (ctx:allowGarbage / checkGarbage).
The table tests testTableEndC, testTableInsertC and testTableSizeC cover the engine's C function wrappers (table.new-like).

testColorConversion.desc: Tests RGB/HSV and hexadecimal color conversions.

testRainbowColor.desc: Tests rainbow color generation at the range bounds.

testColorCreation.desc: Tests the RGBA color constructors and packed value constructors.

testTableToColor.desc: Tests table to color conversion, including with nil values.

testParseColor.desc: Tests parseColor with a hexadecimal, a table and invalid values.

testColorGenerators.desc: Tests that the procedural color generators return valid colors.

testDumps.desc: Tests the dumps format for a few argument shapes (table, several arguments, none).

testNoGarbageDumpDumpsSingleShot.desc: Tests the garbage budget (12288 bytes) of dump/dumps for the common call paths, in a single call.

testLpadRpad.desc: Tests the left padding (lpad) and right padding (rpad) helpers.

testTrim.desc: Tests removal of spaces at the start and end of a string.

testSplit.desc: Tests split: limits and delimiter edge cases.

testStringStrip.desc: Tests string.strip with explicit character classes.

testStringSplit.desc: Tests the variants of the string.split API and its limits.

testStringHash.desc: Tests that string hashing is deterministic.

testBytesToString.desc: Tests formatting of byte sizes across units and edge cases.

testFormatTimeStringNow.desc: Tests the shape of the output of the current-time formatting helper.

testJsonRoundtrip.desc: Tests the JSON encode/decode round trip on simple tables.

testJsonEncodePretty.desc: Tests that pretty (readable) JSON encoding contains formatted keys.

testJsonEncodePrefix.desc: Tests JSON encoding with an optional output prefix.

testJsonEncodePrettyDecodeRoundtrip.desc: Tests the stability of encodePretty followed by decode.

testJsonDecodeEncodePrettyRoundtrip.desc: Tests the stability of decode followed by encodePretty.

testJsonCdataRoundtrip.desc: Tests the JSON handling of BeamNG vec3/quat cdata values.

testJsonDecodeInvalid.desc: Tests the behavior of invalid JSON decoding and log suppression.

testSetOperations.desc: Tests the set-like helpers: membership and updates.

testTableKeysSorted.desc: Tests the sorted extraction of a table's keys.

testTableValuesAsLookupDict.desc: Tests converting an array of values into a lookup dictionary.

testTableMerge.desc: Tests the shallow merge of tables.

testTableRecursive.desc: Tests the semantics of the recursive table merge.

testTableRecursiveArray.desc: Tests the recursive merge when the values are arrays.

testTableSizeC.desc: Tests the wrapper of the C-side table size helper.

testTableEndC.desc: Tests the wrapper of the C-side "table end" helper.

testTableInsertC.desc: Tests the wrapper of the C-side insertion helper.

testTableFindKey.desc: Tests looking up a key from a value.

testTableContainsCaseInsensitive.desc: Tests whether a value belongs to a table, ignoring case.

testArrayFindValueIndex.desc: Tests looking up the index of a value in an array.

testArrayShuffle.desc: Tests that shuffling an array preserves its elements and size.

testTableDepth.desc: Tests the recursive computation of a table's depth.

testTableRoundRobinKey.desc: Tests the round-robin key selection helper.

testShallowCopy.desc: Tests that the shallow copy preserves first-level references.

testDeepCopy.desc: Tests the deep copy, including shared diamond-shaped references.

testCheckTableDataTypes.desc: Tests the helper that validates the data types of a table.

testPathUtils.desc: Tests the path helpers and level name extraction.

testSerialization.desc: Tests the serialization and deserialization helpers.

testLoadIni.desc: Tests INI file parsing and the handling of malformed lines.

testSortedPairs.desc: Tests the deterministic iteration order of sortedPairs.

testShuffledPairs.desc: Tests that shuffledPairs returns each pair exactly once.
